records.title: Accelerating ViT Inference on FPGA through Static and Dynamic Pruning
records.reason: Combines structured weight pruning and dynamic token pruning with an FPGA accelerator for DeiT-Small; reports up to 3.4x lower computation, 1.6x compression, and 12.8x latency reduction vs CPU with about 3% accuracy drop. Concrete transformer inference acceleration, but vision-only rather than LLM.

records.title: Translating Images to Road Network: A Non-Autoregressive Sequence-to-Sequence Approach
records.reason: IEEE/CVF publisher full text was unavailable in this session. The title and abstract describe non-autoregressive image-to-road-network sequence generation, a task-specific vision method; the relationship to general NAR language modeling cannot be confirmed from primary body.

records.title: An Efficient FPGA-Based Accelerator for Swin Transformer
records.reason: Presents an FPGA accelerator for Swin Transformer, optimizing the architecture/dataflow for vision inference. It is a concrete transformer accelerator but focuses on image classification and does not show transfer to language models.

records.title: Register Tiling for Unstructured Sparsity in Neural Network Inference
records.reason: ACM publisher full text could not be accessed. Abstract describes register tiling to speed unstructured sparse neural-network inference, relevant to sparse-kernel execution but not specifically transformers/LLMs; retain as an indirect pruning-lineage candidate.

records.title: Training Recipe for N: M Structured Sparsity with Decaying Pruning Mask
records.reason: The paper develops a pruning schedule for N:M structured sparsity with a decaying mask during training. This supports hardware-friendly sparse models but is a training recipe, and the evaluated inference gains/LLM scope are limited.
